verdict.rationale: Terraform ships a native `terraform test` framework for validating module changes. Tests run against test-specific, short-lived resources, "preventing any risk to your existing infrastructure or state" [docs-27]. Since v1.7.0, provider mocking lets tests run without real resources [docs-28], and test runs emit machine-readable `-json` output suitable for CI [docs-22]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that `terraform test` works as documented, and evidence of the test-authoring details (assertion syntax, test file structure).
